payload_com: At existing between-jaw TCP; balanced central grasp assumed.
rod_mass_model: 8 g per 150 mm; same cross section and density; mass scales with length.
limitations: Static torque only: no acceleration, thermal, grip, rod stiffness, strength, or printed-part assessment.
No collisions or cable limits checked for changed geometries; short rods may not fit the existing fittings.
Search over all six continuous joint angles; demanding poses found are not certified global extrema.
Zero-angle pose changes its TCP position when rod lengths change; it is not a workspace-wide payload rating.
MG4010 geometry remains the existing placeholder for MG5010 mass distributions.
validation: All body masses/COMs reconstructed from CAD meshes and allocations; all candidate gravity torques match potential-energy gradients.

cube_650mm_2kg_free_orientation.assumptions: A 1 m cube beside one upright fixed-base arm; joint 1 at cube mid-height; 10 cm horizontal stand-off.
cube_650mm_2kg_free_orientation.interpretation: Best among numerical IK solutions found; not a global torque minimum or collision check.
cube_650mm_2kg_free_orientation.refinement_note: Constrained SLSQP locally minimizes maximum absolute joint torque at each corner, free orientation, initialized from the best sampled IK solution. No collision check; not a global optimum proof.
